title: net-merge: free Speedify alternative
caption:
Speedify charges $89.99/year to merge your connections. net-merge does it for free ⚡

✅ Combines Wi-Fi, Ethernet and phone hotspots into one faster connection
✅ Works for every app, no proxy setup
✅ Shows the speed of each connection live in your menu bar or tray
✅ No account, no server, no VPN, 100% free

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ It needs two real connections that reach the internet separately (like Wi-Fi plus a phone), and one single download still uses one link. It needs admin rights, and the apps aren't code-signed yet, so Windows or macOS may warn on first launch. The same developer also sells RoutEngine, a commercial per-app version (free for personal use, Pro for work); net-merge itself is free.
